sections.heading: 1. Who we are and what this policy covers

blocks.text: Kyro Learning is an independent educational initiative operated by Ashay Kumar, based in India ("Kyro Learning", "we", "our" or "us"). We provide information and educational resources for parents, teachers, counsellors, students and other interested visitors through kyrolearning.com (the "Website"). This Privacy Policy explains how personal data is handled when you visit the Website, send feedback using "Share Your Perspective", request the "Home Leadership Kit", or contact us.
The operator is responsible for determining the purposes of the personal data processing described in this policy. Questions, privacy complaints and requests may be sent to info@kyrolearning.com.
We collect only information relevant to the service or interaction involved. Depending on how you use the Website, this may include:

Home Leadership Kit requests: name, email address, phone number and any other fields actually displayed on the request form; adult confirmation; necessary acknowledgement of the privacy notice; optional follow-up and marketing choices.
Share Your Perspective: feedback, answers to questions and any optional contact details you choose to provide, together with form acknowledgements and choices.

Submission and audit information: submission or retry identifier, date and time, the versions of notices or consent wording presented, and submission outcome information required to process requests and prevent duplicates.
Communications: information you send us by email or in response to a permitted follow-up.

Technical and security information: IP address, browser/request information, approximate device information, error or security events, and authentication or bot-prevention signals that may be processed by our hosting and security providers.

We do not intentionally request government identification numbers, payment card details, medical records or information about a child through these forms. Please do not include such information in free-text fields.
We use the information for the purpose shown when it is collected, including to:
Receive, organize, review and respond to education-related feedback.
Process Home Leadership Kit requests and provide the download after the backend confirms the submission is stored.
Provide a response or follow-up where requested, chosen or otherwise permitted by applicable law.

Send optional updates or marketing communications only where a separate, valid permission has been provided and such communications are enabled; submitting a form does not automatically subscribe you.
Keep the Website working, protect against abuse and fraud, troubleshoot errors, maintain relevant records and avoid duplicate processing.
Comply with applicable legal obligations and handle valid rights, complaints or lawful requests.

Where processing relies on your consent, the request for consent will specify the relevant purpose. You may refuse optional purposes without losing access to a resource that does not require them. We will not use contact information collected for one stated purpose for an unrelated purpose without an appropriate legal basis and notice.

The educational material on this Website may be read by people of different ages. Our submission forms, however, are intended for adults aged 18 or older. Parents and lawful guardians may request resources for a child using the adult’s own contact information. We ask that you do not include a child’s name, contact details, date of birth, health information or other identifying or sensitive details in the forms or feedback fields.

We do not knowingly use our forms to collect personal data directly from children or engage in targeted advertising directed at children. If you believe a child has submitted personal information, contact us so we can review and take appropriate action. If Kyro Learning later adds child accounts or direct child submission features, we will first introduce the necessary age-appropriate notices, safeguards and parent/guardian consent processes under applicable law.

Submitted form information is transmitted through our website backend and stored in restricted-access Google Sheets. We use Google services for storage and Google Analytics 4, provided by Google, for optional analytics after acceptance. Information you intentionally submit through our forms is separate from the cookie identifiers, device/browser details and network information that Google may process for analytics; we do not pass form submissions or contact details to analytics. We may use Cloudflare for website delivery, backend execution, access control, security and bot-prevention features. Authorized helpers supporting the operation of Kyro Learning may access information only as needed for the specified purposes.

These providers may process data in countries other than India, subject to applicable legal requirements and the providers’ service terms and safeguards. We may also disclose information where required by applicable law, a valid legal process, or to protect the Website and its users. We do not sell personal data. We do not disclose form submissions publicly or use attributed testimonials without appropriate permission.

Kyro Learning currently uses a manually managed Google Sheets workflow, without an automatic deletion schedule. Records may therefore remain stored until an authorized person reviews and removes them. This is an operational description, not a commitment to retain personal data indefinitely or to refuse deletion.

We aim to retain personal data only while it is reasonably necessary for the purpose explained at collection, legitimate operational records, applicable retention requirements, dispute handling or other lawful purposes. We will review requests to delete or correct data and remove information when the purpose has ended or deletion is required, subject to any applicable legal obligation to retain it. Consent withdrawal will stop processing for the withdrawn optional purpose, subject to lawful exceptions; it will not automatically erase processing already completed.

Before the public launch, Kyro Learning will establish a practical manual review and deletion process and the person responsible for carrying it out. We will update this policy if the retention system materially changes.

sections.heading: 7. Your choices, rights and how to make requests

blocks.text: You may contact info@kyrolearning.com to request information about how your data is handled, correction or updating of inaccurate data, deletion where applicable, withdrawal of optional permission, or assistance with a privacy concern. Please indicate which form or communication the request relates to. We may ask for reasonable verification before disclosing or changing personal data.

We will assess and respond to requests in accordance with the Indian laws applicable at the time of the request. Where the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and its relevant provisions are in force, additional statutory rights and grievance remedies will apply as provided by that law. We do not require you to agree to optional marketing in order to make a privacy request.

We use, or intend to use before public activation, appropriate technical and organizational controls, including restricted access to submission storage, server-side handling of sensitive credentials, protected API routing, input validation, abuse protection and transport encryption. Access permissions are limited to people who need them for the operation of the service.

No online system is guaranteed to be completely secure. If we become aware of a data incident, we will investigate, take reasonable containment measures and provide legally required notifications where applicable. Please avoid sharing sensitive information in open text fields.

The Website uses necessary technologies for security and essential operations. Optional Google Analytics 4, provided by Google, measures page visits and broad usage to help us improve educational resources only after you accept analytics. Google may process online identifiers, technical device information and network information, including your IP address during transmission, in countries outside India under its terms and privacy practices. We send only fixed public page titles and allowlisted page locations without query strings or fragments; we do not send form fields, feedback answers, contact details, kit-request information or children’s information to analytics. Advertising features and Google signals are disabled. You may reject analytics without affecting access, forms or downloads, and change or withdraw your choice using Cookie preferences in the footer. See the Cookie Policy for storage, expiry and withdrawal limitations. Cloudflare Access may set reviewer login cookies during private review. External services have their own privacy practices, which we do not control.

We may revise this Privacy Policy as the Website, its data uses and the law change. The published version will show its effective date. Where a change requires a new notice or consent, we will provide it before the relevant new processing begins.
Privacy contact: Kyro Learning, operated by Ashay Kumar, India Email: info@kyrolearning.com Website: https://kyrolearning.com

sections.heading: 1. What cookies and similar technologies are

blocks.text: Cookies are small pieces of information that a website or its providers store in or retrieve from your browser. Similar technologies include local storage, session storage and security tokens. Some are necessary to deliver or protect a service. Optional Google Analytics is available only with your explicit consent; advertising tracking is not enabled.

sections.heading: 2. How Kyro Learning currently uses these technologies

blocks.text: Kyro Learning uses necessary technologies for essential operations and offers optional Google Analytics 4 for measuring public page visits. No Google analytics script or analytics request is loaded before you accept. Necessary technologies may support:
Website operation, secure routing, delivery and troubleshooting.
Protection against unwanted automated submissions or other abuse (for example, a security or bot-prevention service if activated).

Maintaining authentication sessions for authorized reviewers while Cloudflare Access protects the private Website. These review-only cookies may cease to be relevant once the Website is publicly available.
Remembering the visitor’s cookie preference and maintaining necessary security or form workflow state.

Your analytics choice is stored in local storage as kyro.analytics-consent with its version and timestamp for 180 days. Missing, invalid, expired or malformed records leave analytics disabled and prompt a new choice. If storage is blocked, a choice may apply only to the current page session. After acceptance, Google may set first-party _ga and _ga_85B0Q7PSX8 cookies to distinguish visits; this integration requests a 180-day lifetime with automatic renewal disabled. Google may nevertheless refresh its session-cookie expiry during an active visit. Your analytics permission still expires 180 days after your choice unless you make a new choice, and browser restrictions may shorten cookie lifetimes. Necessary hosting and security storage varies by environment.

Strictly necessary: Essential operation, security, authentication where applicable, abuse prevention and storage of your privacy preferences. These may operate without an optional-tracking choice where permitted by applicable law. Blocking them in your browser may impair some functions.

Analytics (optional): Google Analytics 4, provided by Google, measures visits and broad usage to improve the Website. It may process cookie identifiers, device/browser and network information. Page locations exclude query strings and fragments and use only fixed public routes and titles. We do not pass form answers, names, emails, phone numbers, kit-request data or children’s information to analytics. Google signals and advertising consent remain disabled.

Marketing (optional): Advertising or cross-site measurement technologies. These are not planned for the initial launch. If introduced, they must remain disabled until any required consent is obtained.

On your first visit, choose Accept analytics or Reject optional. Analytics is disabled unless you explicitly accept, and optional consent is never preselected. Rejecting has no effect on normal website access, form submission or private kit downloads.

Use Cookie preferences in the footer to view or change your choice at any time. Reject optional withdraws analytics permission immediately, disables collection and removes the isolated analytics frame and accessible first-party GA cookies where technically feasible. Cookies on inaccessible paths, other domains or with browser restrictions may require browser controls. Withdrawal cannot recall requests already sent or erase data Google has already processed. Removal of an already-loaded third-party script alone cannot reverse its prior execution.

Analytics preferences are separate from form acknowledgements and optional follow-up or marketing permissions. Your choice applies to this browser, not automatically to other devices. Changes, expiry or deletion of browser storage may require you to choose again.

You can also block or delete cookies using your browser settings. Browser restrictions may affect protected reviewer login or security checks. Google processes analytics information under its service terms and privacy practices, which may involve processing outside India. See Google’s Privacy Policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy and information about partner-site data at https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites. Hosting and security providers maintain their own documentation and privacy notices.
We may update this policy when technologies change. For questions about the Website’s use of cookies, email info@kyrolearning.com.
